plan.question: Does agreement-sensitive geometric photo pooling materially outperform arithmetic photo pooling on existing S83 validation?
plan.candidate: Normalize exp(mean(log(max(p, 1e-12)))) over all available validation photographs of each lesion; preserve singleton vectors exactly
plan.arithmetic_control: Equal probability mean across the same available photographs
plan.units: All validation lesions and all original validation images; broadcast lesion predictions for the image endpoint
plan.grouping: lesion_id only; no labels, confidence, correctness, diagnosis or image appearance selects photographs
plan.prior: Geometric fusion across models was previously unhelpful; across photographs is a distinct unproven ablation
plan.origin: User authorized one further check after the earlier retrospective arithmetic diagnostic; all previous outcomes remain known
plan.assessment: Exploratory validation development only, with existing lesion overlap; not independent confirmation
plan.fail_action: Stop candidate; do not open old-test prediction files or select another pooling alternative
plan.pass_action: Only permits a separately labelled retrospective old-test diagnostic; does not freeze or upgrade S83
